shared_elements: prominent circular or oval eye/disc within a figure
justification: The most specific overlap is that both include schematic animal-like/profile figures with a prominent circular or oval eye or disc incorporated into the body/head. The major difference is that A is a densely organized multi-register surface with many animals and geometric bands, while B shows essentially a single large curvilinear figure without the same register structure, repeated signs, or accompanying iconographic ensemble.
